headline: Accounts, Sales, the Project Office and the UI screens are LIVE. UX/Dev sprints, QA hand-off, corrections and changes, the team inbox and feedback, dashboard tiles and the go-live hand-over are BUILT and saved on a work branch, not yet released. A full browser run reached 55 of 57 steps (the two QA steps failed on a stale-screen bug, since fixed in code but not re-run). Per the owner, all testing is done after implementation. Existing modules are untouched.
live_health: Database: working (backup taken before every live change)
Existing modules (leave, attendance, projects, TA, chat and others): not affected
Debug mode on the live server switched off (security improvement)

phases.name: Safety net + hardening
phases.delivers: Backups, test environment, automatic checks, on/off switches for new modules, security fixes

phases.name: Accounts module
phases.delivers: Payment approval, advance/pending payments, budget increase, targets, AMC list

phases.name: Sales module
phases.delivers: Leads, project creation, sales inbox, meeting requests, sales dashboard

phases.delivers: Accept project, department budgets, project tabs with payment lock, out-of-scope approval

phases.name: UI / UX / Dev workflow
phases.delivers: Pages and sections, sprints, effort approval, QA hand-off, corrections with budget

phases.name: Team Lead + resource screens
phases.delivers: Task inbox with priorities, team list, feedback, ratings

phases.name: Dashboards + feedback
phases.delivers: Dashboards for every role, monthly customer feedback, appreciation approval

phases.name: HR performance + go-live
phases.delivers: HR performance views, full testing, load test, rollout

phase0_tasks.task: Take a live database backup before any change
phase0_tasks.note: Backup taken before every release. Restore test passed: backup restored into a separate database with identical data (92 tables, 71 users, 687 tasks), then removed

phase0_tasks.task: Local test database that matches the live system
phase0_tasks.note: Live structure saved as a reusable file; new test environments build in minutes

phase0_tasks.task: On/off switch for each new module
phase0_tasks.note: Live. New modules stay hidden until switched on; tested

phase0_tasks.task: Login protection against repeated wrong passwords
phase0_tasks.note: Live and confirmed: blocks after 10 wrong tries for one user, others unaffected

phase0_tasks.task: Automatic test check on every code change
phase0_tasks.note: Running on GitHub; passes. Blocks new failures only
Done 23 Oct with backup and checks
165 tests: 125 pass, 40 were already failing; list saved so new breakage is caught

phase0_tasks.task: Safety test for every read screen of every module
phase0_tasks.note: About 90 screens checked for 3 roles (Super Admin, Team Lead, Employee) on every change; none crash

phase0_tasks.task: Login expiry (90 days) and overall request limit per user
phase0_tasks.note: Live. Nobody was logged out (no login was older than 90 days). Expired logins are cleaned daily

phase0_tasks.task: Sessions and cache moved off the database
phase0_tasks.note: Live. Lighter load on the database for every page; site checked after the change
Found a bug on live (errors every 5 minutes); fixed and released. Please confirm the dashboard shows alerts and recent activity

phase0_tasks.task: Walk through every test workflow with a real browser (self-test)
phase0_tasks.note: Claude ran all 40 steps in a real browser on a local copy. First run 36 passed; the 4 problems found were fixed and released; the re-run passed 40 of 40
Needs a new sub-domain, web address (DNS) and certificate on your hosting account

phase0_tasks.task: Protect the main branch on GitHub (review required)
phase0_tasks.note: Would stop direct pushes to main; needs a decision on the team's workflow
Must not be run against the live site; will run on the test copy
Mostly biometric and leave tests written before recent changes

done_this_update: Built corrections and changes with effort, cost and budget approval
Built the resource inbox, team lead to-do list, team list and monthly feedback (four fixed questions)
Built dashboard tiles on My Work for managers, coordinators, team leads and QA
Built payment request to Accounts and the server and go-live hand-over for the system admin team
Fixed the stale-screen bug that kept the QA review panel on Open after taking it
Nothing was tested or released in this update, by the owner's instruction
next: Finish the remaining modules (HR performance views, appreciation, meetings) once the manager answers
Then one full test of everything: backend suite, whole browser run, fix what fails
Then merge, back up and release to the live server in one controlled step
Manager's answers (formula, ratings, customer feedback, meetings) and your approvals (staging, GitHub review rule)
capacity_answer: The database will not break with 100+ users working at once. The live server is strong (24 processors, 40 GB memory). Improvements planned in Phase 0 (lighter background checks, rate limits, caching) give comfortable room for 150 to 300 users at the same time. A load test will confirm the exact number.

risks.risk: Sessions and cache were in the database

risks.action: Fixed: every signed-in user is now limited to 300 requests per minute
New failures are blocked meanwhile; review planned

risks.risk: An old unused copy of the app and its old database remain on the server
No safe place to load-test yet
Sales fields were built from the manager's sheet, not the Sales document
risks.action: Adjust once the document arrives; small change

risks.risk: Project manager role is assumed to be the PMO team leads
risks.action: Confirm; changing it is a one-line rule

decisions: Send the Sales document fields. Phase 2 (Sales module) cannot start properly without them
Approve creating the staging (test) copy: needs a sub-domain, DNS entry and certificate on your hosting
Require review before merging to main on GitHub? (safer, but slows direct pushes)
Send the Sales document fields (needed for Phase 2)
How is budget per department calculated (sections x animation level)? Who can change it?
Rating formula for Project Coordinators and resources (HR approval needed)
Customer feedback questions, and who enters them
Meetings: simple request/approve, or full calendar invites?

Google review count: manual entry or automatic?
Keep the old bug tracker alongside the new bug flow, or replace it?
Go-live: pilot team first, or everyone at once?

changelog.text: Paused by the owner. UX and Dev sprints are built and saved on a separate branch, not yet released. Local test machines shut down.
Phase 4 slice 1 (UI department work screens) built, installed and switched on.
Full browser self-test re-run: 40 of 40 passed.
Self-test of all workflows run; 4 issues found and fixed; fixes released.
Project Office built, installed and switched on for the PMO teams.
Sales module built, installed and switched on for the Sales team.
Accounts module switched on for the Accounts team; access by department; PMO teams notified.
Phase 1 Accounts module built and installed on live (hidden). 8 new tests.
Login expiry, request limit, faster sessions/cache released to live. Backup restore test passed. Super Admin dashboard bug fixed.
Safety features (module switch, login protection) released to live and verified. Automatic checks active on GitHub.
Plan approved. Phase 0 started. Live debug mode off, live code updated, switch + login protection + automatic checks built.

phase1_tasks.note: Advance and later payments; the project coordinator and sales person are notified when a payment is approved
Logged with a reason; management and HR are notified
Reason is required; recorded in the audit log; coordinator and PMO notified
Saving again for the same month updates it
Shows Expired automatically after the end date; filter for contracts ending in 30 days

phase1_tasks.task: Access by department (Accounts team) and menu
phase1_tasks.note: Live. Accounts team members and Super Admins see the menu; Sales team member checked and correctly blocked

phase1_tasks.note: Backup first; 5 new tables added, nothing existing changed; site checked after every step

phase2_tasks.note: Mark done with an outcome and set the next follow-up date, or cancel
